name: qkd_ctrl_pc_port_s2-s2-COMMIT
purpose: KVCTRL split 2026-10-16 (Codex-prescribed, no third same-shape retry, no waiver): e1 one HBM root 17,150 sinks at measured insertion 426.8 ps (>300 rule) and e2 plateaued at native_commit_identity -58.453 ps. qkd_ctrl_pc_host_static becomes a wires-parent of three hardened roots: core (scheduler/tags/CDC/observer/drain, ~13.3k hclk sinks est), port (actual ot_qfd_emb_pcport KVW2/RQD64 + its data pin flops, ~2.9k), ECC (actual ot_qfd_kv_landing_ecc, ~0.9k). Every seam output flop-driven; priced edges: native commit +1 hclk (new pin register; SDC moves native_commit_* to the hclk domain), static write data +1 hclk into the port (hidden, column >= 4 edges later), KV read/write 0.
